correctness.rationale: Precisely 54 length-six binary words have least period six, yielding 32 five-bit overlap vertices with balanced degrees 22 of degree two and 10 of degree one. The rooted 31x31 directed Laplacian has exact integral determinant 389120, and BEST factorial factors are all one. Under bit complement the quotient has 27 edges and 16 vertices, determinant 320, and 13 odd-voltage edges, so precisely 320 cyclic Euler tours are self-complementary. Four palindromic and six reverse-complement-palindromic primitive windows exceed a reflection’s two fixed window starts; Burnside produces 97360 orbits, 160 of size two. The included pure Python fraction-free integer matrix calculation and independent exhaustive C++ Euler tour enumerator agreed: VERIFY_OK; all paths replayed from the new package.

value.rationale: The first word length with simultaneous nontrivial proper divisors 2 and 3 is six; its primitive-word overlap graph is therefore the first mixed-period exclusion test case. Counting every universal circular host and its complement/reversal symmetry classes is a natural exact invariant for cyclic exhaustive test-sequence generation. The 320 fixed cycles are explained by an odd-voltage quotient rather than an unmotivated numerical table. The classification is not a routine one-letter increment and does not pretend to solve larger composite orders.
